title: Spend the remaining day on what lasts
summary: This meets the life acting as if time were still abundant. The line says the day is shrinking, so use it for the profit of Naam now.
takeaway: Use the shrinking day for what endures.
lifeApplication: When another evening starts disappearing into nothing, interrupt it on purpose. Turn one remaining hour toward the work that can still follow you.

source.shortMeaning: Life is shrinking, so spend it on what can endure beyond it.
source.lifeApplication: When time slips, turn one remaining hour toward the profit of Naam.
